title: "DeGroot Research Group Resources"

Welcome to the public knowledge base of the DeGroot Research Group at Western University. It collects
practical know-how and background notes that group members have found useful, written by and for
students and researchers working in computational fluid dynamics and related areas.

## Sections

[Theory](theory/index.qmd)
: Explainers on CFD and numerical methods, such as gradient reconstruction, discretization schemes and solver algorithms.

[Software](software/index.qmd)
: Practical how-tos for the tools the group uses, such as matplotlib and ParaView.

[OpenFOAM](openfoam/index.qmd)
: Notes on using and understanding OpenFOAM, the group's main CFD code, from reading solver output to case setup.

[Project Management](project-management/index.qmd)
: How we plan and track research work, from termly objectives down to the tools that run the process.

[Policies](policies/index.qmd)
: General, publicly shareable information on how the lab operates.

## Contributing

Group members add and improve pages through pull requests on
[GitHub](https://github.com/DeGrootResearchGroup/GroupResources). See the
[contributing guide](https://github.com/DeGrootResearchGroup/GroupResources/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
to get started.

## Suggest a Page

If you'd like to suggest a new page, please open an [issue](https://github.com/DeGrootResearchGroup/GroupResources/issues) 
on the GitHub repository.
